purpose: Deny a noun or な-adjective description.
keywords: Noun / な-adjective + ではない; conversational じゃない.
Today is not a day off.
formation: Noun / な-adjective + ではない; conversational じゃない.
register: ではない is formal/plain; じゃない is conversational.
restrictions: Polite speech commonly uses ではありません or じゃありません.
mistake: い-adjectives normally form their negative with ～くない.
